parent_objective: run Candidate B promotion/generalization gate without promotion
blocked_by: Candidate B has public replay evidence but has not passed fresh promotion/generalization checks

public_gates: M1022 must recompute exact temporal retention
M1022 must run proof replay and source-diverse diagnostics

M1022 must not train, run PPO, use private holdout, or promote
forbidden_shortcuts: do not skip fresh public generalization
do not tune thresholds after seeing failures

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether Candidate B can become a promotion-audit candidate after fresh public generalization and behavior checks
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: promotion-candidate gate only; no actual promotion, no PPO, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if exact temporal retention fails
stop if proof replay or source-diverse diagnostics fail
stop if fresh public or moderate-OOD generalization regresses
fallback_plan: if exact retention fails, route to exact-retention audit
if proof fails, route to proof washout audit
if generalization fails, route to generalization regression audit
if behavior fails, route to behavior regression audit
if all tiers pass, route to a separate promotion audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1021 admits Candidate B promotion/generalization gate

hypothesis: Candidate B can pass a no-training promotion/generalization gate against the M974 public base after passing M1019 full public replay.
success_criteria: proof replay and source-diverse diagnostics are evaluated
fresh public and moderate-OOD generalization are evaluated
no promotion, PPO, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: fresh public or moderate-OOD generalization regresses
the gate promotes Candidate B or uses private holdout
decision_rule: M1022 may only classify Candidate B as a promotion-audit candidate; actual promotion must be a separate milestone.
